about.heading: Small senior team.
about.first: Lumarq started when a handful of engineers and designers got tired of watching good ideas stall between handoffs. So we built the studio we wanted to hire: no juniors learning on your budget, no account-manager telephone — just the people doing the work, talking to you directly.
about.second: Today we partner with startups and established businesses to plan, build and grow web platforms, mobile apps and search programs, with weekly demos and a codebase you fully own.
about.mission: Our mission: make great software feel inevitable — clear plans, honest timelines and products that keep paying back.
